segments.sn52.6:1.2: Ekamantaṃ nisinno kho āyasmā sāriputto āyasmantaṃ anuruddhaṃ etadavoca –
segments.sn52.6:1.3: “katamesaṃ āyasmā anuruddho dhammānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññataṃ patto”ti?
segments.sn52.6:1.4: “Catunnaṃ khvāhaṃ, āvuso, satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññataṃ patto.
segments.sn52.6:1.6: Idhāhaṃ, āvuso, kāye kāyānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ;
segments.sn52.6:1.9: dhammesu dhammānupassī viharāmi ātāpī sampajāno satimā, vineyya loke abhijjhādomanassaṃ –
segments.sn52.6:1.10: imesaṃ khvāhaṃ, āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā mahābhiññataṃ patto.
segments.sn52.6:1.11: Imesañca panāhaṃ, āvuso, catunnaṃ satipaṭṭhānānaṃ bhāvitattā bahulīkatattā sahassaṃ lokaṃ abhijānāmī”ti.

lines: Chaṭṭhe sahassaṃ lokanti iminā therassa satata vihāro dassito.
Thero hi pātova mukhaṃ dhovitvā atītānāgate kappasahassaṃ anussarati.
Osadhibhāvāpekkhāya itthiliṅganiddeso, tabbahulatāya taṃ vanaṃ “kaṇḍakīvanan” teva paññāyittha.
Dasacakkavāḷasahassaṃ ekāvajjanassa āpāthaṃ āgacchati tathā ālokavaḍḍhanassa katattā.
